newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Dollar-rupiah band said to be widened when needed.
newsitem.headline: Dollar-rupiah band said to be widened when needed.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Tuesday the government would widen the bank's dollar-rupiah intervention band when needed.
"We are doing okay. We will do it when it is needed," he said during an question-answer session at a seminar in Jakarta.
The central bank widened the band last September to 8.0 percent from 5.0 percent. The bank intervenes in the market when the dollar-rupiah rate falls out of the band.
The band was set at 2,346/2,538 rupiah against the dollar on Tuesday.
